hooks.text: 在35个联动异常中判断路线：无异常继续下楼，有异常就反向上楼
hooks.excerpt: 35 carefully designed and interlocking abnormalities, and other secrets hidden in the office building, are waiting for your discovery! If there is no abnormality, just go downstairs normally. If there is an abnormality, you can go to the next floor by going upstairs.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 被困诡异办公楼的加班族必须赶回家休息，因为第二天早上还要上班
hooks.excerpt: You are a tired office worker who works overtime until late at night because of the heavy workload. You have to go home and rest quickly because you have to go to work tomorrow morning.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 以手绘像素和2D平台形式呈现异常办公楼，每个像素均经细致制作
hooks.excerpt: Inspired by "Exit 8", it is presented in the form of hand-painted pixel art and 2D platform, each pixel is carefully crafted!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
